package.name: rm_livox_gz_sim
package.description: Opt-in Gazebo Fortress (ignition-gazebo6) Livox MID-360 backend for this repo. Ships only OUR assets: the SDF world/model (SDF <= 1.9), the ros_gz_bridge config and the `sim_backend:=gz` launch entry. The third-party sensor system (uos/rmagine + uos/rmagine_gazebo_plugins + ashduwihch/mid360_gazebo_harmonic) is NOT vendored here: tools/scripts/gzsim/fetch_and_patch_mid360.sh fetches it at pinned revisions, applies our patches and builds it into a separate prefix.
